bill_a.title: COMPREHENSIVE KANSAS TAX-SYSTEM REPLACEMENT
bill_a.description: Engineer a new Kansas tax structure built around property rights, transparent transaction taxation, taxpayer supremacy, controlled revenue distribution, debt discipline, exit mechanisms, and constitutional permanence.

bill_b.title: KANSAS PROPERTY-TAX ELIMINATION
bill_b.description: Eliminate recurring taxation of owned property while engineering replacement revenue and transition mechanisms for counties, cities, school districts, and other local governments.

bill_c.title: KANSAS NBEF ACT
bill_c.description: Determine how the Node-Based Educational Framework (NBEF) can be translated into Kansas law without destroying the structural controls that make NBEF work.
